role: One 16x16x16 section of a chunk: block id low bytes and high nibbles, metadata, block light and sky light nibble arrays, plus the non-air and random-ticking block counts that gate the random tick.
scope_reason: All block and light storage, and the tickRefCount that decides which sections receive random ticks.

members.name: yBase
members.note: Implicit: section s covers y 16s..16s+15 in the flat array.

members.name: blockRefCount
members.note: Not tracked; a section that exists is kept present by the mask even when all air. Vanilla reads it via isEmpty (Chunk.getAreLevelsEmpty, the client renderer and chunk packets); I did not confirm whether any server-tick path depends on it.

members.name: tickRefCount
members.note: chunk.sections_ticking[16], a counter maintained on every write and rebuilt on load.

members.name: blockLSBArray
members.note: chunk.ids (uint16, low 12 bits the id) in x << 12 | z << 8 | y.

members.name: skylightArray
members.note: chunk.sky; always allocated, gated by chunk.no_sky (hasNoSky).

members.name: ExtendedBlockStorage
members.note: Section creation is setting a mask bit on a zeroed range (set_block_step, chunk_set_light, chunk_construct).

members.name: func_150818_a
members.note: The id store and tickRefCount update; blockRefCount is not kept.

members.name: getNeedsRandomTick
members.note: servertick.c skips a section whose count is 0.

members.name: removeInvalidBlocks
members.note: The tick count is rebuilt from ids on snapshot load and for inserted start chunks (world.c chunk_count_ticking) and on checkpoint load (serverreplay.c sr_ensure_saved); blockRefCount is not.

members.name: setBlockLSBArray, setBlockMetadataArray, setBlocklightArray, setSkylightArray
members.note: Checkpoint load unpacks the saved arrays into the flat chunk.

members.name: setBlockMSBArray
members.note: only AnvilChunkLoader.readChunkFromNBT calls it, for a section with an Add array, which only block ids above 255 need; 1.7.10 has none, so no save holds one

notes: The flat 65536-cell per-chunk arrays (about 320 KB per chunk) replace per-section objects; a section that does not exist reads air and default light via chunk.mask. blockRefCount is left as a member-level gap, not a file-level missing behavior, because I found no server path that reads it. Gates not re-run.
